title: Active window screenshot
description: Capture the active Hyprland window, save it to Pictures, copy it to the clipboard, and notify with the saved path.

title: Main + side stack layout
description: Toggle the current workspace between dwindle and a master layout with the focused window on the left and the other windows stacked on the right.

title: Spotify TUI
description: Open or focus the spotify_player TUI while playback stays on the daemon device.

# script: # Media-key bindings are deferred until their playerctl/SwayOSD fallbacks are ported to Omarchy Quattro.

title: Volume up
description: Route volume up to spotify_player when Spotify is active; otherwise use Omarchy system volume.

title: Volume down
description: Route volume down to spotify_player when Spotify is active; otherwise use Omarchy system volume.

title: Next track
description: Route next to spotify_player when Spotify has playback focus; otherwise use the active media player.

title: Play/pause
description: Route play/pause to spotify_player when Spotify has playback focus; otherwise use the active media player.

title: Pause
description: Route pause to spotify_player when Spotify has playback focus; otherwise use the active media player.

title: Previous track
description: Route previous to spotify_player when Spotify has playback focus; otherwise use the active media player.

title: Spotify TUI process
description: Connect the daemon device and run the control-only spotify_player build with the TUI config and shared cache.

title: Spotify debug state
description: Write a read-only Spotify daemon, MPRIS, Hyprland, playback, and log snapshot under /tmp.

title: Spotify control validation
description: Validate daemon count, playback routing, play/pause, and Spotify volume sync.
